newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Singapore to review robusta coffee contract.
newsitem.headline: Singapore to review robusta coffee contract.

text.p: The Singapore Commodity Exchange (SICOM) is reviewing its robusta coffee contract, which has been plagued by poor turnover, its general manager said on Thursday.

"It's being addressed by the coffee committee. I think we'll come to a decision in two to three months time," Lim Toh Eng told Reuters in an interview at an Asia coffee conference here. "The contract will carry on."
He told the conference that turnover in the coffee contract between March and December 1995 reached only 31,180 tonnes.
Trading volume in calendar year 1996 reached 105,590 tonnes, largely as a result of incentives to spur trading in the contract.
"We are now looking for ways and means to (spur) interest in the coffee contract," Lim said.
